Projects

Automated Tape Peeler

Onshape · 36:1 gear reduction · 0.87 mm/s peel rate

A servo-driven peeler I designed in Onshape to automate removal of the sacrificial PSS layer during wet-transfer. A compound gear train reduces the servo output 36:1 for a controlled peel speed, and a dedicated gripper holds the thermal release tape (TRT) steady through the peel. The concept is adapted from a simpler realization of a Stanford-style graphene exfoliator.

RPG Avionics Bay Holder

Onshape · 3D-printed

A simple bracket that secures the COTS flight computer inside BU Rocket Propulsion Group's subscale rocket airframe.

Square-to-Round Exhaust Transition

Onshape · Ozone cleaner exhaust

Connects the lab's ozone cleaner, used in the film degradation testing above, to the building's round exhaust pipe, with a smooth square-to-round wall transition for manufacturability.
